title: imap/session/mailbox.rs: iterative DP glob matcher prevents ReDoS
description: glob_bytes uses a two-row DP table, not recursive backtracking. This is O(m*n) with a 1KB combined length cap that bounds worst-case work to ~256KB operations per LIST command. A future contributor might suggest replacing it with a simpler recursive glob or using the glob crate — both would reintroduce exponential blowup from adversarial patterns like %%%%%%%%...%. The current implementation is correct for IMAP LIST semantics (% does not cross '.') and is DoS-safe.
